sloka: ततः सम्भाषिता देवी सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता ।रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता ।। ५.६५.१६ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sambhāṣitā devī sarvamarthaṁ ca darśitā ।rāmasugrīvasakhyaṁ ca śrutvā prītimupāgatā ।। 5.65.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "When the divine lady talked to me, I presented all the facts about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. On hearing me, virtuous Sita, whose devotion is fixed on you became delighted.
translations.hindi: वेदवेद्ये परे पुंसि जाते दशरथाव्सजे । वेदः प्राचेतसादासोत्साचाद्रामायणात्मना
